note: Triennial election of Ballymena Rural District Council (and Guardians); nominations received on Wednesday 6 May 1936 by Mr. John Leckey, clerk and returning officer. 'There were only two changes in the personnel of the old Board, viz., in the Kells division, where Joseph Maybin, junr., was nominated in the room of his father, Mr. Joseph Maybin, J.P., and in the Lisnagarron division where Wm. H. Simpson was nominated in the place of his father, Hugh Simpson. Only 18 nominations were received out of the 23 electoral divisions, leaving 5 divisions viz. Tullygarley, Toome, Dunminning, Newtowncrommelin, and Ballyconnelly, as they were, so that the old members for these divisions were declared returned' (Ballymena Observer, 8 May 1936, p. 10, image-read). No poll; the statutory polling day in Co. Antrim was Thursday 4 June 1936. Only the two new members are named in the report, so only Kells and Lisnagarron are recorded (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Added from reports of the new council's meetings early in the term, each division inferred from the previous return: Ahoghill, Ballyclug, Ballyconnolly, Broughshane, Clough, Cloughogue, Crumkill, Dunminning, Galgorm, Glenbuck, Glenravel, Glenwherry, Kirkinriola, Longmore, Newtowncrommelin, Portglenone, Slemish, Toome and Tullygarley. division inferred from the 1 June 1933 return (Mrs. W. R. Young; Ballymena Observer, 5 May 1933, p. 10); the Ballymena Observer, 7 August 1936, p. 6 names the member as sitting for the new council (monthly meeting of Ballymena Rural Council, Saturday 1 August 1936). The 1933 list as transcribed gives 'Mrs. W. E. Young'; the meeting reports print 'Mrs. W. Young' and 'Mrs. W. R. Young, J.P.' Returned unopposed.
